signIn.note: Your risk desk starts here. Sign in to manage your accounts.
register.note: Build your discipline. Start with a paper account.
password.hint: Use 12–128 characters. Spaces count and are preserved.
email.invalid: Enter a valid email address of at most 254 bytes.
code.hint: Enter the current 6-digit code. Wait for a new code after each successful use.
code.invalid: Enter exactly 6 digits from your authenticator.
code.title: Verify your identity
code.note: Your password was accepted. Enter your authenticator code within five minutes.
settings.note: Manage access to your trading desk.
twoFactor.note: Add an authenticator to protect sign-in with a time-based code.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code in your authenticator, or enter the secret manually. Keep the secret private.
twoFactor.disableNote: Confirm your password and a fresh code. Other sessions will be signed out.
twoFactor.enabledNotice: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Wait for a new code before using it again. Other sessions have been signed out.
twoFactor.disabledNotice: Two-factor authentication is disabled. Other sessions have been signed out.
twoFactor.noRecovery: Recovery codes are not available yet. Keep access to your authenticator.
error.badRequest: Check the fields and try again.
error.credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
error.code: The code is invalid, expired or already used. Use a fresh code; if sign-in has expired, start again.
error.disable: The password or code is incorrect. Use a fresh authenticator code.
error.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
error.duplicate: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
error.conflict: Two-factor settings have changed. Reload settings and try again.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
error.network: Could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
